name: cache-watch
description: Warns you (desktop popup, phone push, optional sound) a few minutes before this session's prompt cache goes cold

warnMinutes.title: Warn this many minutes before the cache goes cold
warnMinutes.description: Minutes left on the cache when the notification is sent

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime in minutes
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after the last request (60 for a 1-hour cache, 5 for a 5-minute one)

desktop.title: Desktop notification
desktop.description: Show a desktop notification that stays until dismissed (Windows through WSL, or notify-send on Linux)

phone.title: Phone push
phone.description: Try a push to the Claude app on your phone. It only arrives while this session has Remote Control connected (/remote-control)

awayMinutes.title: Count me away from the machine after this many minutes
awayMinutes.description: The phone is only tried when the machine itself says nobody has touched it for this long. Below it, the desktop popup has already reached you

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play the reminder sound with the notification

log.title: Keep a firing log
log.description: Append one line per warning to ~/.cache/cache-watch/fire.log, with the clock's drift. Read it with `/cache-watch log`
